hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]\s*)git commit( |$)' && [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = main ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"On main: this repo is PR-only. Branch first (git checkout -b <topic>), then commit."}}' || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.py) .venv/bin/python -m ruff check -q "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; true
